package.description: An SQL query, scripting, editing, and exporting tool for Oracle databases.

en-US.description: An SQL query, scripting, editing, and exporting tool for Oracle databases.
en-US.longDescription: Golden is a query tool for Oracle databases. It includes advanced query abilities, data editing, and powerful import and export abilities including support for Excel and Calc spreadsheets. It features close compatibility with SQLPlus scripting conventions including bind variables, variable prompting and script parameter passing.
en-US.name: Benthic Software: Golden 6.x

zh-CN.description: 用于 Oracle 数据库的 SQL 查询、脚本编写、编辑和导出工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Golden 是一款用于 Oracle 数据库的查询工具，具有高级查询功能、数据编辑功能以及强大的导入和导出功能，支持 Excel 和 Calc 电子表格，并紧密兼容 SQLPlus 脚本约定，包括绑定变量、变量提示和脚本参数传递。
